name: fund-review
description: End-to-end quote generation and financial-review pre-audit for government IT procurement, split into three tool layers: (1) a region-neutral BOM with a controlled vocabulary and NESMA quality gates, co-created in Feishu; (2) region baselines built from BOM x standard pack where every parameter carries a page-level citation, diffable across regions; (3) per-deal quotes applying delivery mode, subsystem-level scope and project factors. Emits procurement lists, function-point worksheets, operating-period costs, TCO comparison, compilation notes and a self-audit report; consistency violations fail loudly rather than silently.
